note: C7: top-level directive forms after the ns are parsed like ns clauses — `(require '[clojure.string :as s])` registers the alias (the s/join call resolves to clojure.string/join and the raw `s/join` target is forbidden), `(import '(java.util Date))` records the class import. Also pins the (:import [pkg Cls…]) vector form: items are the CLASSES (Date/UUID), not the package wildcard.
